lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 3 to 5 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank, transitioning to a linear horizontal sequence towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary columns of high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice structure with the most intense nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge to a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible posterior section of the first dorsal fin displays approximately 6 high-luminance blobs of varying size, predominantly concentrated towards the lower half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small reddish-orange protrusions, potentially ectoparasites, are visible on the upper mid-flank and near the leading edge of the upper caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Several commensal fish (remoras) are visible near the ventral surface and the second dorsal fin; the second dorsal fin exhibits a distinct lack of internal high-luminance blobs compared to the primary flank.
